title: RepositoryObject
description: A file or folder in the Control Room repository

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the repository object

parentId.description: ID of the parent folder containing this object

name.description: Display name of the file or folder

path.description: Full repository path from the workspace root

size.description: File size in bytes (0 for folders)

version.description: Version number of the file (for versioned bot files)

lastModifiedBy.description: Username of the user who last modified this object

lastModifiedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification

createdBy.description: Username of the user who created this object

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the object was created
